covered_perils: Peril 01: Windstorm and hurricane gusts exceeding 55 mph
Peril 02: Sudden and accidental water intrusion directly resulting from roof envelope puncture
Peril 03: Hail impact damage causing structural shingle fractures
exclusion_clauses: Exclusion A: Pre-existing wear-and-tear, metal corrosion, rust, or deferred maintenance
Exclusion B: Mold or fungal remediation exceeding 14 calendar days post-event
Exclusion C: Cosmetic or non-structural paint fading without compromised moisture barrier

valuation_and_indemnity_terms.settlement_standard: Replacement Cost Value (RCV) less applicable exclusions
valuation_and_indemnity_terms.depreciation_schedule: Exclusion of identified pre-existing deterioration schedules
valuation_and_indemnity_terms.basis_points_resolution: Adjudicated proportionally based on verified qualifying loss proportion
